title: Fourteen Springs and One Short Sign
subtitle: 旅游出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅游出行（人与社会·交通与旅游）
meta: 主题语境：旅游出行（人与社会·交通与旅游）　|　核心词汇：east　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 east 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1938 my grandfather ① chose the east that no driver in the town would have taken, and he said the choosing was the whole of the spring. The ② east, meaning the direction and not the region, ran fourteen springs and stayed unnamed in the book; the east, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left untaken.

Every ③ east in that town had the same short sign at the end of it, and the ④ east at the end, meaning the one they kept for the goods trucks and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An east, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to take; my grandfather said the taking is the part that fills fourteen springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the east was the whole of the story, meaning the region and not the direction. The ⑥ east, meaning the region and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody longs for and nobody visits; east, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a direction and a region. He said the region is the part they remember.

By 1947 the ⑦ east had become a line in a map, and the map had become an argument about the short sign. The ⑧ east of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was one town and fourteen springs of taking; east, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to take. She said the taking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ east I remember is the one named in the map, which closed in 1959 and is still described as the quietest in the town. An ⑩ east, my grandmother said in 1961, is the only one that improves by being taken; every east, she said, is a region that has agreed to look like a direction. She said the region was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 东；东边那条路（指那个镇子分岔处的那一条）
B. n. 东；东方（指那个方向本身，与东部地区相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the east 选东边（那条路）
D. n. 东；东边那条路（指留给货车的那一条）
E. n. 东；东方（抽象总称，指一个镇子的出行之事）
F. n. 东；东边那条路（指地图上写到、被标名的那一条）
G. n. 东部地区；东方（指故事里人人都向往却无人去过的那片地方）
H. n. 东部地区（抽象总称，指人人都向往却无人去过的那种地方）

answers.why: choose the east 意为“选东边那条路”，1938 年祖父选了镇子上没有一位司机肯走的东边那条路。
east 意为“东、东方”，指那个方向本身而不是东部地区，它经过了十四个春天而在簿子上没有名字。
east 意为“东、东边那条路”，指那个镇子上的每一条东向的路，每一条到头都有同一块小小的路牌。
east 意为“东、东边那条路”，指留给货车的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
east 意为“东部地区、东方”，指故事里人人都向往却无人去过的那片地方，叔叔说这片东部就是那个故事的全部。
east 意为“东部地区”，指人人都向往却无人去过的那种地方而不是那个方向，是故事里人人都向往、却无人去过的地方。
east 意为“东、东边那条路”，指地图上写到、被标名的那一条，到 1947 年这条路成了地图里的一行。
east 意为“东、东方”，祖父四月写道，整件事的出行之事是一个镇子和十四个春天的上路。
east 意为“东、东边那条路”，我记得的是地图上标名的那一条，1959 年封了，至今仍被说成镇子上最安静的一条。
east 为抽象总称，祖母 1961 年说，一条东向的路是唯一会因为被好好上路而变得更好的东西。
